title: Nucleus and Orbit: Atoms, Necessity, and the Science of an Interwoven Practice
creator: Cory Snell
description:
A free, evidence-based companion to the System of Inevitability, Book 5: the system's atomism, 3-6-9 architecture, and quantum language set beside the real science of atoms, necessity, chaos, the fractal body, and interdependence, tying together Books 1 to 4. By Cory Snell, creator of the System of Inevitability. Book 5 of the series Companions to the System of Inevitability.

Also in this series, Companions to the System of Inevitability:

  • Book 1: Walking and Turning
  • Book 2: Wave and Return
  • Book 3: Shape and Choice
  • Book 4: Lens and Lattice
